feed.content: Larkhaven Library public schedule: this Saturday we are OPEN from 10:00 to 18:00. The reading room and book returns are available.
The Larkhaven park picnic is on Sunday at 12:00. Bring a reusable cup.
The community garden welcomes volunteers on Wednesday afternoon.

User 7 quoted a post from User 10. Quote content: Planning a Saturday library visit? The library’s public schedule says it’s open 10:00–18:00, with the reading room and book returns available. That conflicts with the all-day closure post circulating here; I’d use this published schedule rather than pass along the closure claim..
